title: Dataset Featurization: Uncovering Natural Language Features through Unsupervised Data Reconstruction
reasoning: The paper includes an extensive case study on extracting features from LLM jailbreak tactics, which directly involves evaluating model responses to prompts designed to bypass ethical and safety safeguards.
